28e9b855.text:
The Mauradine Centaur of Desolace.

When you use shamanism to empower your people, it demands harmony with nature. The wind answers your call because it chooses to. You are its champion, and it becomes the power that lets your people soar. However, the Mauradine have no respect for this balance.

This particular clan has only wielded this power for selfish gain. Hunting parties flying across the plains to stalk their foes, spellcasters channeling great storms to burn villages. And even this is not enough. They have created totems of hideous power, forcing the elements to bend to their will.

It is not for us to decide Azeroth's desires, but one thing is clear. The Mauradine are no friends to the elements.
28e9b855.title: The Walks of Shaman

57d4e03b.text:
The Mirefin Murlocs of Dustwallow Marsh.

Murlocs have an innate connection to water as any seafolk, but in a curious way. Many species can recognize the elements in nature without tapping directly into it. The murlocs, however, not only can call upon water, but wield it with surprising intelligence.

Their oracles have a curious affinity for restorative magic. Water is a source of healing for all creatures, from hydration to medicine, but the murlocs managed to tap into its even deeper sources of power. What takes some adepts decades to master, some murlocs seem to be born with this gift.

If this were any other $c, one would think this to be a blessing. But they are murlocs, after all. Their healing magic is as much a weapon as any other, keeping their hunters sharp and their shores battle-ready. Using totems is curious for a species like this, but make no mistake. They are as corrupt as their masters.
57d4e03b.title: The Walks of Shaman

78d3fd0c.text:
Azeroth is home to a host of brilliant creatures. It shows no favoritism. If you learn to listen to her, feel her presence and answer her call, it is simple to wield her strengths.

With time and patience anyone can hear the elements, but our totems lend us a conduit with which to channel this power. More civilized cultures only bestow a totem on those who have proven themselves worthy, but a suitably powerful $c can create one at will.

We have seen such creatures wield the elements for evil. With enough corruption in the land, Azeroth cries out for protectors against these twisted totems. With enough of the corrupted conduits, one can even call upon the tainted elements and banish them back to the planes.
78d3fd0c.title: The Walks of Shaman

85302983.text:
The Stonevault Troggs and Dustbelcher Ogres of the Badlands.

The element of fire is often misunderstood as a source of destruction. While uncontrolled fire is indeed the mark of an uncontrolled spirit, a focused flame lights homes and staves off the bitter cold. A people who learn to master this element are sure to be prosperous--both in battle and at home.

Troggs are rather simple creatures. They aren't known for great demonstrations of power or even particularly cohesive aggression. It wasn't until their discovery of fire that they were even considered a culture worth investigating. But the elements show no favoritism.

Ogres, on the other hand, are known for their strength, cruelty, and even cunning. They forge alliances, and fight in organized groups. They can be quick to turn on their allies and each other, embodying fire's spread and fury.

The element of fire may respect keeping these cultures alive, but certainly not how their totems have been used for blind cruelty.
85302983.title: The Walks of Shaman

bc13bd7f.text:
The Lost Ones of the Swamp of Sorrows.

Earth is the element of fortitude and steadiness. A $c capable of harnessing the earth's power can guarantee their people sturdy homes and durable warriors. What could otherwise flatten another combatant can be shrugged off by one gifted by the powers of earth.

It can also be used to crumble others.

When left to their devices, the Lost Ones rarely interfere with the goings on of other cultures. They stalk about in a mindless fugue state as if they don't truly belong anywhere. The only thing that offers them grounding is the elements.

Unlike the others mentioned, it is not necessarily believed that the Lost Ones have a genuine desire for harm. Earth offers them solace in their aimless wandering. However, with this comes their dependence.

Calling on the elements for aid is one thing, but demanding their presence is another. They are our guides, not our crutches. Now their totems are just as twisted as the Lost Ones themselves.
bc13bd7f.title: The Walks of Shaman

10537|c27b3101.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
10537|c27b3101.text: We cannot take care of all the threats in this area alone. We could use another fighting hand, $N.

10668|19e45338.name: Beaten Corpse
10668|19e45338.text:
The body is that of a female orc warrior.

It is clear that she died in battle, probably against the quilboar in the area.

11106|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Sikewa
11106|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

11899|c5ceacbe.name: Shardi
11899|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1387|c5ceacbe.name: Thysta
1387|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2055|288436fb.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
2055|288436fb.text: The Royal Apothecary Society shall heed The Dark Lady's call to uncover the New Plague and drive Arthas and his heathen Scourge Army from the world once and for all.

2425|7dca81fc.name: Varimathras
2425|7dca81fc.text:
Do not presume to speak to me as though you are my equal, $c. Sylvanas is my queen, and I will do as she bids.

If you do not show the proper respect, I assure you, we can find a more than suitable place for you in the Nether.

But there is no reason we cannot have words if you wish to aid the Dark Lady...

253066|02560e06.name: Umarak
253066|02560e06.text:
An outsider approaches me?

I doubt we have much to discuss, unless you are here to aid an old Kolkar.

262492|ca9aee41.name: Rimblat Earthshatter
262492|ca9aee41.text:
I've been expec...

<Rimblat coughs.>

Excuse me, old habit. I am Rimblat of the Earthen Ring.

268048|fb906211.name: Darkspear Emissary
268048|fb906211.text: $C, we could use more help out at Darkspear Islands against the Theramore Expeditionary Force. Are you willing to join in?

269152|3bad330d.name: Tylana Clawhoof
269152|3bad330d.text:
Greetings, $c. I am happy Anshe has guided you to me today. I would be proud to sell you one of our finest kodos once you have trained with Kar.

The kodo is a noble beast, but is prone to its own behaviors that make it different than most steeds. Once you learn from Kar you will have no issues traversing the world with one at your side.

2733|10e876c3.name: Apothecary Jorell
2733|10e876c3.text:
Are you here to make a contribution to research? 

Do you have any limbs you're willing to part with?

2861|c5ceacbe.name: Gorrik
2861|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3007|501c3600.name: Una
3007|501c3600.text: Cairne has brought us to a land rich with possibilities for the future. We have been fortunate, and so in turn we pass on our good fortune to others. That is why I began teaching, $N.

3030|8fca8484.name: Siln Skychaser
3030|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

3430|71e13f0e.name: Mangletooth
3430|71e13f0e.text:
My hatred is strong <snort>, but the time is right to tell you a tale, $r.

Long ago a battle took place between gods. Agamaggan, our great boar god, fell to the earth after being defeated in the War of the Ancients, his blood raining down and his bones torn asunder. <snort>

Great thorns reached up out of the earth where his blood touched the ground, and his skull adorns one of the caverns to the south.

3432|f6d45601.name: Mankrik
3432|f6d45601.text:
I thank you, $N. Your dedication to my plea gives rest to my lost wife's spirit, and for that I could never repay you enough.

I cannot say that my hatred will ever cease for the quilboar, but it is satiated for now.

Now I must begin to rebuild my life.

3446|36457281.name: Mebok Mizzyrix
3446|36457281.text:
Yes yes yes!  You're just the $r I'm looking for!

Sit!  We have much to discuss!!

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4877|fe134d60.name: Jandia
4877|fe134d60.text: Hail, friend. Can I interest you in any of my trade supplies?

5412|84db224c.name: Gurda Wildmane
5412|84db224c.text: The centaur clans rule the wastes of Desolace. If united, they would be a terrible force. It is then good that the centaur clans are not united but instead bicker and war amongst themselves.

5641|c4db07ba.name: Takata Steelblade
5641|c4db07ba.text: The main threat Thrall wishes dealt with is the Burning Blade--members of the Horde that have given their loyalty to the demons. They seek to practice their dark magic and care little for Thrall's vision of the Horde's future here in Kalimdor.

6026|c5ceacbe.name: Breyk
6026|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

8359|6fec0ef7.name: Ahanu
8359|6fec0ef7.text: Greetings.  If you are here for leather goods, then you will find my wares well crafted.

1088-progress.name: Braelyn Firehand
1088-progress.text: When my master bade me to the peak of Stonetalon, I expected that all I would need was to lay waste to the night elves that crawled the sacred ruins of our ancient temple of Azshara, their touch despoiling its sanctity... but Ordanus had slipped my grasp.
1088-progress.title: Ordanus

1102-progress.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-progress.text:
Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?
1102-progress.title: A Vengeful Fate

1109-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
1109-progress.text: Ah, I see you have returned. Were you able to procure any Kraul Guano?
1109-progress.title: Going, Going, Guano!

1131-progress.name: Melor Stonehoof
1131-progress.text: Have you defeated the foul Steelsnap, $N?
1131-progress.title: Steelsnap

1150-progress.name: Dorn Plainstalker
1150-progress.text:
You must be prepared spiritually, physically and mentally for the challenges that lie ahead of you.

Too often do we rush forward before we are ready. I consider it my duty to the youth, no matter which tribe they belong to, to prepare them for the dangers they may face after they leave the sanctity of their home.
1150-progress.title: Test of Endurance

1153-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
1153-progress.text:
I saw the travelers again--the ones that would not sell me a sample of the ore. I spit at them for not helping the warchief.

May they die in battle like cowards and not like warriors as should be the right of all people who ally themselves with the Horde.
1153-progress.title: A New Ore Sample

1195-progress.name: Zangen Stonehoof
1195-progress.text: Once we have the filled phial, we can send it along to my associate, Rau, in the Thousand Needles. He was the one who requested the phial of water, so he'll better know how we can make use of it.
1195-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1196-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1196-progress.text: I don't suppose you've been sent by Zangen, hm?
1196-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

1197-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
1197-progress.text: I am eager to put my hands upon the Cloven Hoof. Have you taken it yet?
1197-progress.title: The Sacred Flame

2-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
2-progress.text: Yes, mighty $c, I sensed your arrival.  I trust you have more news to report to me about your hunt?
2-progress.title: Sharptalon's Claw

23-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
23-progress.text: Ah - $N - I was just thinking about you!  How goes your hunting?
23-progress.title: Ursangous's Paw

24-progress.name: Senani Thunderheart
24-progress.text: Greetings once again, $N!  Have you come to show me proof of your hunt?
24-progress.title: Shadumbra's Head

4767-progress.name: Elu
4767-progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
4767-progress.title: Wind Rider

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

496-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
496-progress.text: I see you are back.  I hope you were able to gather the agents I need.  Another deathless day will put me in such a gloomy mood.
496-progress.title: Elixir of Suffering

501-progress.name: Apothecary Lydon
501-progress.text: I remember you, $N.  You were going to help me out in concocting my latest elixir.  I'll need that blood before I can bring my own special brand of misery to the inhabitants of Hillsbrad.
501-progress.title: Elixir of Pain

5042-progress.name: Mangletooth
5042-progress.text:
I will need 4 blood shards if you wish Agamaggan's strength, $r.

Your foes will cower before your strength were you to be given this blessing. <snort>

The Razormane's greatest warriors are infused with such power!
5042-progress.title: Agamaggan's Strength

5043-progress.name: Mangletooth
5043-progress.text:
My tribes greatest scouts are said to be unrivaled in their accuracy, and no rogue <snort> could measure up to their quickness in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will make you even more agile than any quilboar born.
5043-progress.title: Agamaggan's Agility

5044-progress.name: Mangletooth
5044-progress.text:
The $c and geomancers of the quilboar tribes <snort> call upon the strength of Agamaggan to help them in battle and in their rituals, $r.

If you too wish the added power of Agamaggan's blessing with your spells, then bring me 4 blood shards and Mangletooth will aid you. <snort>
5044-progress.title: Wisdom of Agamaggan

5045-progress.name: Mangletooth
5045-progress.text:
Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle.

Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
5045-progress.title: Rising Spirit

5046-progress.name: Mangletooth
5046-progress.text:
All those who <snort> enter battle have need of protection. Their bones must be strong. Their skin tough. <snort> My tribe knows this as well, and to add to the natural protection our quills and hide give us, <snort> we often call upon Agamaggan to protect us from harm before we go to war.

Bring me 4 blood shards <snort> and I will grant you the same protection.
5046-progress.title: Razorhide

5052-progress.name: Mangletooth
5052-progress.text:
Our tribes flock to the thorny areas throughout the Barrens <snort> because they are holy places, but none as holy as Razorfen. Agamaggan's body makes up the entirety of the Razorfen, <snort> but the Downs are especially protected because the entrance is made from his great maw! <snort> It will swallow whole those not loyal to him, and spit out their bodies after he's chewed them up! <snort>

Agamaggan has left his body behind to protect us, and he gives of his spirit so we may protect him. <snort>
5052-progress.title: Blood Shards of Agamaggan

513-progress.name: Master Apothecary Faranell
513-progress.text: Can you not see I am busy, $c?  The Dark Lady insists on a new plague before the Scourge advance from Northrend overwhelms us.  And with the human threat pressing from the south, time becomes my most precious commodity.  This better be important!
513-progress.title: Elixir of Agony

5421-progress.name: Jinar'Zillen
5421-progress.text:
I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps.  If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon?  For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!
5421-progress.title: Fish in a Bucket

5881-progress.name: Grish Longrunner
5881-progress.text: You have news from Maggran Earthbinder?
5881-progress.title: Calling in the Reserves

6283-progress.name: Maggran Earthbinder
6283-progress.text:
Bloodfury Ripper is a nasty creature! You will have success finding her along the western hill line in the Charred Vale.

The bloodfuries will be helpless with out... surely we can vanquish them forever!
6283-progress.title: Bloodfury Bloodline

6301-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6301-progress.text: The continuous destruction caused by war and those that seek a profit from lumber pains me deeply. To aid the cycle of rebirth and replenish the lands, I need Gaea seeds. Do you have them, $c?
6301-progress.title: Cycle of Rebirth

6381-progress.name: Tammra Windfield
6381-progress.text:
These seeds you plant are strong, resisting corruption, and making a foothold for other life. They will grow and grow, first preventing corruption and healing the scarred land, and then one day, restoring Stonetalon to a lush forest, once again.

Have you planted all of the Gaea seeds?
6381-progress.title: New Life

6393-progress.name: Tsunaman
6393-progress.text: The Tribunal of the Tides grows impatient. They seek to end this war that has raged across all dimensions for eons. My brethren are anxious to hear news of the glorious victory over the hated fire elementals. Have you the Incendrites that I require?
6393-progress.title: Elemental War

6441-progress.name: Pixel
6441-progress.text: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
6441-progress.title: Satyr Horns

6442-progress.name: Marukai
6442-progress.text: The naga increase in numbers, $N. Please complete this task for me.
6442-progress.title: Naga at the Zoram Strand

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6504-progress.name: Gurda Ragescar
6504-progress.text: I hope you find the pages soon, $N! I really need to get back to work!
6504-progress.title: The Lost Pages

6522-progress.name: Varimathras
6522-progress.text: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.
6522-progress.title: An Unholy Alliance

6561-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
6561-progress.text:
May the Earthmother be with you, $N.

Peace between the earth and all her people should be our goal. She has a grand plan for nature, and we all have a role to play in that plan.
6561-progress.title: Blackfathom Villainy

6571-progress.name: Locke Okarr
6571-progress.text: I hope you can come through with the supplies! I'm in big trouble if I don't deliver them soon!
6571-progress.title: Warsong Supplies

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6921-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6921-progress.text: Have you been successful in locating the fathom core?  Without it we'll have no idea what the Twilight's Hammer is exactly up to down there.
6921-progress.title: Amongst the Ruins

6922-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
6922-progress.text: Ah, hello again $N.  I was just reading the waves the sea, much like I always do.  What brings you to the outpost?
6922-progress.title: Baron Aquanis

6981-progress.name: Falla Sagewind
6981-progress.text: Hello, $r. What can I do for you?
6981-progress.title: The Glowing Shard

7321-progress.name: Christoph Jeffcoat
7321-progress.text: Any luck finding the ingredients?  I'll tell you, the alliance maggots are far too numerous in this area now... In my opinion, they have come far too close already...
7321-progress.title: Soothing Turtle Bisque

79094-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79094-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79094-progress.title: The Lessons of Ta'zo

79360-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79360-complete.text:
Hmmph... One thing's certain. Whoever this note is from is right about their preparations going unseen. We've been too busy dealing with the centaur and harpies to send out wind riders to patrol the canyons.

You have our gratitude for alerting us to this threat, but we might still need further assistance.
79360-complete.title: Elemental Aid

79360-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79360-progress.text: Danger? There's been no reports of anything like that. And our wind riders are far too busy to spend their time chasing ghost stories.
79360-progress.title: Elemental Aid

79361-accept.name: Prate Cloudseer
79361-accept.text:
So the quilboar mean to flood the Thousand Needles with their twisted shamanism, do they? It seems almost unimaginable, but you yourself have seen that these creatures are not to be taken lightly.

I had wished to continue your training in earnest, but there is no time for that now. These lands are home to many different creatures, friend and foe alike, and none of them deserve such a fate. We must act.

Take this tome. It was meant for study, but may now hold the key to dispersing this coming storm.
79361-accept.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79361-complete.name: Prate Cloudseer
79361-complete.text: I can feel their corruption from here. The twisted elementals the quilboar are summoning should be drawn to the cleansing ritual.
79361-complete.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79361-progress.name: Prate Cloudseer
79361-progress.text: There are many who practice shamanism in this world. It is up to us to ensure that the land is protected from misuse.
79361-progress.title: Storm, Earth, and Fire

79364-accept.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79364-accept.text:
The note you found says the Razormane have burrowed into the Thousand Needles for some sort of unseen ritual. Raging storms and rising tides...

The quilboar must be using some cruel sorcery they learned from Hirzek, a $c who went to great lengths to twist the elements. If they plan to flood the canyon, this would require devastating elemental powers.

We are ill equipped to deal with this, but a powerful $c like you must have an idea. Return to your allies and see if you can't find an answer.
79364-accept.title: Eyes on the Sky

79364-complete.name: Prate Cloudseer
79364-complete.text: You have returned. Do you see the skies darkening? What news have you about the quilboar threat?
79364-complete.title: Eyes on the Sky

79365-accept.name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
79365-accept.text:
Here mon, a Squall-breakers Potion be what you need. Drink this to protect yourself against the elements of the storm, but remember it only goin' to last for a short while.

Now go, return to your friends in need. There's nothing more I can do for you.
79365-accept.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79365-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79365-complete.text: Our wind riders have found something, but they have been unable to get close enough to assess the situation. Were you able to find anything that might help us?
79365-complete.title: With Wind Beneath Your Wings

79366-accept.name: Prate Cloudseer
79366-accept.text:
Now that you have the twisted totems, we must wield them to summon forth the corrupted elementals the quilboar are calling upon. Defeat them to cleanse these lands and put an end to the Razormane's abominable ritual then report back to Rau Cliffrunner with your success.

You should begin your clensing at the steam pools to the west. That area is rich with each of the elements. But be careful, $N. The quilboar will not sit idly while you interrupt their plans.
79366-accept.title: Heed My Call

79366-complete.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79366-complete.text: The rumbling ground fell silent and in my heart I knew you had saved us. You have our gratitude, $N. You do your Earthen Ring proud.
79366-complete.title: Heed My Call

79366-progress.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79366-progress.text: Have you any news of the storm?
79366-progress.title: Heed My Call

79442-accept.name: Rau Cliffrunner
79442-accept.text: Our people cannot thank you enough, but I have no real use for this eye. I have heard of an old $c in the Alterac mountains that has an eye for storm elemental magic. Perhaps he may be able to craft something for you.
79442-accept.title: The Tempest's Weapons

79442-complete.name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
79442-complete.text:
Ah, this be a powerful artifact, friend! I haven't crafted with some'ting like this in a long time.

You take good care o' dis now, ya here? Looks like ya went through plenty to get it!
79442-complete.title: The Tempest's Weapons

79442-progress.name: Bath'rah the Windwatcher
79442-progress.text:
Great battle with de elements, mm? Tings turned out how they was always meant to.

But since you here, what brings you to ol' Bath'rah?
79442-progress.title: The Tempest's Weapons

824-progress.name: Je'neu Sancrea
824-progress.text:
Ah, hello there.  I spend a great deal of time studying the water - all the elements really - so much so that sometimes I don't even notice people around me.

Is there something I can help you with?
824-progress.title: Je'neu of the Earthen Ring

86576-progress.name: Mor'rogal
86576-progress.text: I have important matters to consider, $c. Be quick.
86576-progress.title: Bloodfury Trinkets

879-progress.name: Mangletooth
879-progress.text:
How goes your hunt, $r? <snort>

Thork thinks he knows the truth about who leads the raids against his people, <snort> but he shall learn how wrong he is if you are successful.

My death is inescapable, but you have caused great pain to my enemies, so Mangletooth regrets nothing. <snort>
879-progress.title: Betrayal from Within

889-progress.name: Mangletooth
889-progress.text:
Bring Mangletooth 10 blood shards and I will bless you with great speed. You will run with zhevra and the wind will be jealous of you.

It will not last long, but it should be enough to help you travel throughout the Barrens.
889-progress.title: Spirit of the Wind

893-progress.name: Tatternack Steelforge
893-progress.text:
I, too, have doubts that the pathetic quilboars could attain any level of skill in the area of smithing, but I do as the Warchief commands, and I shall learn what I can about the Razormane tribe.

I have had more menial tasks, and I do so willingly if it aids the orc people.
893-progress.title: Weapons of Choice

913-progress.name: Jorn Skyseer
913-progress.text: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
913-progress.title: Cry of the Thunderhawk

94239-accept.name: Unknown
94239-accept.text: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting 1 Fine Leather Pants, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94239-accept.title: Craftsman's Writ: Fine Leather Pants

94239-complete.name: Alyce
94239-complete.text:
Oh! The pants? Ah, I realized shortly after writing this that I needed a full set of clothes - new overalls included.

If it will get you out of my hair, I suppose I should honor the request. After all, you did make an arduous journey to find me.

Take this, now please...

<She gestured in a polite but firm shooing motion.>
94239-complete.title: Craftsman's Writ: Fine Leather Pants

94239-progress.name: Alyce
94239-progress.text: Move along, please, and try not to draw attention to us.
94239-progress.title: Craftsman's Writ: Fine Leather Pants

95664-progress.name: Bashana Runetotem
95664-progress.text: Spirits honor you. Have you come to share with us?
95664-progress.title: Elder Knowledge

95682-progress.name: Deathstalker Agent
95682-progress.text: We're here to get the important job done. If you can help, prove it.
95682-progress.title: Open the Maw

95697-progress.name: Borstan
95697-progress.text: Farm-raised boar, farm-raised crawler... what's next, farm-raised raptor?
95697-progress.title: Changing Tastes

95774-progress.name: Mankrik
95774-progress.text: I have only memories now, but I will build a tribute to Olgra so that they never fade.
95774-progress.title: Her Name Is Olgra

96222-accept.name: Umarak
96222-accept.text:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
96222-accept.title: Khan Hratha

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96259-accept.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-accept.text:
There is an ancient $r burial ground at the place called Gloomrise, just northwest of this camp. Of late it has been infested with a particularly vicious brood of spiders. These spiders not only pose a threat to the people of Mulgore, they are also damaging a site that most $r consider to be sacred.

It would be of great service if you could travel to Gloomrise and put an end to this infestation. The ancestors will surely smile upon you if you see this done.
96259-accept.title: Defending the Dead

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

96774-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96774-progress.text: How you doin' mon? Job done yet?
96774-progress.title: Ancient Gurubashi Idol

97538-complete.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-complete.text:
Ah, thank you, $N.

It means much to me to have you venture all the way out there for what must seem a trivial notion from an old $r, but with your kindness I will have enough pigment for the rest of the season.

Thank you for supporting my livelihood, and I will strive to create something magnificent with the pigments you have brought.
97538-complete.title: Pigments for Paints

97538-progress.name: Tah Winterhoof
97538-progress.text:
You have returned! Were you able to find the mirkweed plant pods in Mirkfallon Lake?

We $r have used this plant pigment in our paints for generations, so any amount you manage to bring would be appreciated. Though there are many ways to get a red pigment, I find the mirkweed to give the richest and most vibrant hue of the methods I'm familiar with.
97538-progress.title: Pigments for Paints

97539-accept.name: Doctor Gregory Victor
97539-accept.text:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.
97539-accept.title: Silky Sutures

97985-progress.name: Calder Gray
97985-progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.
97985-progress.title: Thundering Hearts

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool
